scope: Historical records with preserved response text; reconstructed thematic records are not treated as answer evidence.
principles: Evaluate whole-answer quality separately from component-level strengths.
Do not promote historical wording merely because a component is useful.
Do not infer missing answer quality from a question theme or historical label.

records.whole_response_caveat: Exactly-three-paragraph and no-handoff constraints are scenario-specific, not universal.
Archive-specific framing remains provisional when no canonical source is retrieved.
Recovered historical record should not independently multiply the same lesson.
Conflict reasoning must not become a generic template for every stewardship question.
Focused follow-up is context-dependent and not required after every practical answer.
Relationship or organizational context should be established before applying this framework.

provenance_limited_records.rule: Question themes may be retained as future calibration prompts, but no answer-level best practice is harvested until source responses are recovered or independently re-tested.
